paragraphs.en: Long-term memory for AI coding agents. Quit Claude Code mid-task, start OpenAI Codex in the same directory, continue without re-explaining the architecture, the failed approaches, or the open questions.

paragraphs.en: Your coding agent probably has a memory feature already. Claude Code takes its own notes, Cursor remembers some things, and every platform is adding more. They all have the same limits: the notes live on one machine, belong to one agent, and drop out of view when you switch tools or hand the work to a teammate.
paragraphs.zh: 你的编程智能体可能已经有记忆功能了。 Claude Code 会自己做笔记，Cursor 会记住一些内容，而且每个平台都在增加更多此类功能。 它们都有同样的局限：笔记只存在于一台机器上，只属于一个智能体，并且当你切换工具或将工作交给队友时，它们就会淡出视野。

paragraphs.en: It follows you across agents. More than twenty harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Grok, Devin, Kimi, Kiro, and others) feed one shared memory. Quit Claude Code mid-task, open Codex in the same directory, and the next agent picks up a handoff that says where you left off, what failed, and what is still open. Handoffs are a typed protocol: each one has an owner and is claimed exactly once.
paragraphs.zh: 它会跨智能体跟随你。 二十多个工具外壳（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、OpenCode、Grok、Devin、Kimi、Kiro 等）共同写入一份共享记忆。 在任务中途退出 Claude Code，在同一目录下打开 Codex，下一个智能体就会接手一份交接记录，说明你进行到哪里、哪些失败了、还有哪些待办。 交接记录是一种带类型的协议：每份交接都有一个所有者，且只能被认领一次。

paragraphs.en: It can carry the session, not just a summary. Start agents with ai-memory run : quit Claude Code, run ai-memory run codex , and Codex gets the shared workstream plus a private, temporary local projection of Claude's visible native history for exact details the bounded startup packet omitted. The remote server receives only the harness and session identity, never the local transcript path or body. Direct harness launches behave exactly as before.

paragraphs.en: It follows you across projects. A small profile of how you usually work (your package manager, test layout, architecture habits) reaches every new repository at session start, so you stop re-explaining yourself. It sits below each repository's rules file as a default. It is on by default for a single user, and on a shared server it is opt-in and private per person. See docs/cross-project-profile.md .

paragraphs.en: Your memory is plain markdown. The source of truth is a git-backed wiki of ordinary .md files: grep it, open it in Obsidian, edit it by hand, rsync it. The database is a derived index that can always be rebuilt from the files. There is no vector store to maintain and no content locked in a binary blob.
paragraphs.zh: 你的记忆就是普通的 markdown。 事实的来源是一个由 git 管理的、由普通 .md 文件构成的维基：可以对它进行 grep，可以在 Obsidian 中打开它，可以手动编辑它，也可以用 rsync 同步它。 数据库只是一个派生索引，随时可以从文件重建。 没有需要维护的向量库，也没有被锁在二进制大对象中的内容。

paragraphs.en: It captures the work itself, silently. Lifecycle hooks record what happened (prompts, tool calls, session boundaries), sanitize it at a typed privacy boundary before anything is stored, and the server consolidates it into readable pages. You do not have to ask it to remember anything. The default path uses zero LLM calls : capture, search, and handoffs all work with no API key.
paragraphs.zh: 它默默捕获工作本身。 生命周期钩子记录发生的事情（提示词、工具调用、会话边界），在任何内容被存储之前，在类型化的隐私边界对其进行净化处理，然后服务器将其整合为可读的页面。 你不必要求它记住任何东西。 默认路径使用零次 LLM 调用：捕获、搜索和交接都无需 API 密钥即可工作。

paragraphs.en: It ages memory without an LLM. Memory decays on a schedule you can tune per tier, and memory you use decays slower : opening a page, searching it, or reaching it through a link counts as use. When episodic notes go cold they can be compacted down to their durable facts (file paths, error codes, decisions) instead of dropped. Near-duplicates collapse into one, and likely contradictions get flagged, all with zero API calls . Nothing is hard-deleted: the original stays in git and the version chain ( restore-page brings it back). Access-weighted retention is always on because it can only keep memory longer . The parts that rewrite or drop content (compaction, dedup, per-tier curves) stay off by default until you turn them on.
paragraphs.zh: 它无需大语言模型即可让记忆老化。 记忆按一个你可以逐层级调整的时间表衰减，而被使用的记忆衰减得更慢：打开一个页面、搜索它或通过链接访问到它都算作使用。 当情节笔记变冷后，它们可以被压缩为其中持久的事实（文件路径、错误代码、决策），而不是被直接丢弃。 接近重复的内容会合并为一条，可能存在的矛盾会被标记出来，这一切都无需任何 API 调用。 没有任何内容会被硬删除：原始内容保留在 git 和版本链中（restore-page 可以将其恢复）。 访问加权的保留机制始终开启，因为它只会让记忆保留得更久。 会改写或丢弃内容的部分（压缩、去重、逐层级曲线）默认保持关闭，直到你手动开启。

paragraphs.en: It can also "dream", if you let it. With an LLM configured, an opt-in background pass rewrites whole clusters of cold notes into single coherent pages while you are idle, and cancels as soon as you come back to work. It never deletes a source (the pre-merge versions stay reachable), it is off by default, and it has to pass a recall eval before it could become default behavior. Unless you ask for more, the zero-LLM path above is what runs.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你允许，它还可以“做梦”。 在配置了大语言模型之后，当你闲置时，一个可选开启的后台流程会把整组冷门笔记重写为单个连贯的页面，而你一回来工作它就会立即取消。 它从不删除任何来源（合并前的版本仍然可以访问），默认处于关闭状态，而且必须通过一项召回评估才有可能成为默认行为。 除非你要求更多，否则运行的就是上述零大语言模型路径。

paragraphs.en: capture ──▶ consolidate ──▶ recall ──▶ handoff hooks session-end search next agent, observe summaries as + brief any harness silently wiki pages injection Agents emit sanitized observations through lifecycle hooks as you work. At session end, observations become coherent markdown pages in the project's wiki (optionally LLM-written; useful even without). The next session, in any agent on any machine, gets a bounded brief and can search everything: full-text, entities, links, and (optionally) vectors, fused into one ranking. Cross-agent handoffs pass the baton explicitly.

paragraphs.en: curl -fsSL https://github.com/akitaonrails/ai-memory/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh ai-memory setup install.sh downloads the release for your OS and CPU, checks it against the release's published SHA-256 checksum (it refuses to install without a match), and links ~/.local/bin/ai-memory . ai-memory setup then creates the data directory with a bearer token in an owner-only file, starts a per-user service (systemd --user or a launchd LaunchAgent), and wires MCP, hooks and Agent Skills for every agent it finds, or the ones you name with --agent . It shows the plan, with where it found each agent, and asks first: answer y , or type the numbers of the agents to wire. --plan prints the plan and changes nothing, --web shows the plan as a page in your browser and applies the agents you tick there, --yes skips the question, and running it again changes nothing. Afterwards, restart your agents and ask one of them "What do you remember about this project?" to see it answer through ai-memory. Details, the environment variables and how to verify the script before running it are in docs/install.md . An AI agent installing ai-memory for you can follow INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md .
paragraphs.zh: curl -fsSL https://github.com/akitaonrails/ai-memory/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh ai-memory setup install.sh 会为你的操作系统和 CPU 下载发行版，并根据发行版公布的 SHA-256 校验和进行核对（如果不匹配则拒绝安装），并将 ~/.local/bin/ai-memory 建立链接。ai-memory setup 随后会创建数据目录，并在一个仅所有者可读的文件中保存持有者令牌（bearer token），启动一个按用户运行的服务（systemd --user 或 launchd LaunchAgent），并为它找到的每个智能体、或你用 --agent 指定的智能体配置 MCP、钩子（hooks）和智能体技能（Agent Skills）。 它会显示计划，包括在每个位置找到的智能体，并先询问你：回答 y，或输入要配置的智能体的编号。--plan 只打印计划且不做任何更改，--web 会在浏览器中把计划显示为一个页面并应用你在那里勾选的智能体，--yes 跳过询问，而再次运行则不会做任何更改。 之后，重启你的智能体，并询问其中一个「关于这个项目你还记得什么？」，看看它是否通过 ai-memory 来回答。 细节、环境变量以及如何在运行脚本前对其进行验证，请见 docs/install.md。 由 AI 智能体为你安装 ai-memory 时，可以遵循 INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md。

paragraphs.en: The Docker quick-start below has no authentication : the container never runs init , so it starts without a token. The server binds to loopback only, so nothing outside the machine can reach it, but local processes and browser pages can. Native installs that run ai-memory init get a bearer token by default; see Security below for that and for adding a token here.
paragraphs.zh: 下面的 Docker 快速启动没有身份验证：容器从不运行 init，因此启动时没有令牌。 服务器仅绑定到回环地址，因此机器外部的任何东西都无法访问它，但本地进程和浏览器页面可以。 运行 ai-memory init 的原生安装默认会获得一个持有者令牌；相关内容以及在此处添加令牌的方法，请参阅下文的安全部分。

paragraphs.en: # 1. Install the ai-memory CLI wrapper (a small shell script that # runs the binary inside a container with your $HOME mounted). This is # the only thing that needs to live on the host filesystem. mkdir -p ~ /.local/bin wrapper_tmp= " $( mktemp -d ) " trap ' rm -rf "$wrapper_tmp" ' EXIT wrapper_base=https://github.com/akitaonrails/ai-memory/releases/latest/download/ai-memory-wrapper curl -fsSL " $wrapper_base " -o " $wrapper_tmp /ai-memory-wrapper " curl -fsSL " $wrapper_base .sha256 " -o " $wrapper_tmp /ai-memory-wrapper.sha256 " expected= " $( awk ' NR == 1 { print $1 } ' " $wrapper_tmp /ai-memory-wrapper.sha256 " ) " if command -v sha256sum > /dev/null 2>&1 ; then actual= " $( sha256sum " $wrapper_tmp /ai-memory-wrapper " | awk ' { print $1 } ' ) " else actual= " $( shasum -a 256 " $wrapper_tmp /ai-memory-wrapper " | awk ' { print $1 } ' ) " fi [ -n " $expected " ] && [ " $actual " = " $expected " ] || { echo " wrapper checksum mismatch " >&2 ; exit 1 ; } install -m 0755 " $wrapper_tmp /ai-memory-wrapper " ~ /.local/bin/ai-memory rm -rf " $wrapper_tmp " trap - EXIT # Most distros put ~/.local/bin on PATH automatically. If `which # ai-memory` comes up empty, add this to ~/.bashrc / ~/.zshrc: # export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" # 2. Start the server. `--restart unless-stopped` makes it come back # on docker daemon restart and on machine boot (provided your # docker service is enabled at boot — `sudo systemctl enable # docker` on most distros). Loopback-only bind (`127.0.0.1:49374`) # so nothing outside this machine can reach it. Omit the LLM / # EMBEDDING lines for zero-LLM mode — FTS5 search still works # without any keys. docker run -d --name ai-memory \ --restart unless-stopped \ -p 127.0.0.1:49374:49374 \ -v ai-memory-data:/data \ -e AI_MEMORY_LLM_PROVIDER=anthropic \ -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-... \ -e AI_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai \ -e OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... \ docker.io/akitaonrails/ai-memory:latest # 3. Wire your agent CLI in two commands. The wrapper takes care of # mounts and each client's config-path detection.
paragraphs.zh: # 1. 安装 ai-memory CLI 包装器（这是一个小的 shell 脚本，# 会在容器内运行二进制文件，并挂载你的 $HOME）。 这是唯一需要放在宿主文件系统上的东西。mkdir -p ~ /.local/bin wrapper_tmp= " $( mktemp -d ) " trap ' rm -rf "$wrapper_tmp" ' EXIT wrapper_base=https://github.com/akitaonrails/ai-memory/releases/latest/download/ai-memory-wrapper curl -fsSL " $wrapper_base " -o " $wrapper_tmp /ai-memory-wrapper " curl -fsSL " $wrapper_base .sha256 " -o " $wrapper_tmp /ai-memory-wrapper.sha256 " expected= " $( awk ' NR == 1 { print $1 } ' " $wrapper_tmp /ai-memory-wrapper.sha256 " ) " if command -v sha256sum > /dev/null 2>&1 ; then actual= " $( sha256sum " $wrapper_tmp /ai-memory-wrapper " | awk ' { print $1 } ' ) " else actual= " $( shasum -a 256 " $wrapper_tmp /ai-memory-wrapper " | awk ' { print $1 } ' ) " fi [ -n " $expected " ] && [ " $actual " = " $expected " ] || { echo " wrapper checksum mismatch " >&2 ; exit 1 ; } install -m 0755 " $wrapper_tmp /ai-memory-wrapper " ~ /.local/bin/ai-memory rm -rf " $wrapper_tmp " trap - EXIT # 大多数发行版会自动把 ~/.local/bin 加入 PATH。 如果 `which # ai-memory` 没有输出，请把以下内容添加到 ~/.bashrc / ~/.zshrc： # export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" # 2. 启动服务器。`--restart unless-stopped` 让它在 docker 守护进程重启以及机器开机时自动恢复运行（前提是你的 docker 服务已设置为开机启动——在大多数发行版上执行 `sudo systemctl enable # docker`）。 仅绑定回环地址（`127.0.0.1:49374`）# 因此本机之外无法访问它。 省略 LLM / # EMBEDDING 行即可使用零 LLM 模式——无需任何密钥，FTS5 搜索仍然可用。 docker run -d --name ai-memory \ --restart unless-stopped \ -p 127.0.0.1:49374:49374 \ -v ai-memory-data:/data \ -e AI_MEMORY_LLM_PROVIDER=anthropic \ -e ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-... \ -e AI_MEMORY_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai \ -e OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... \ docker.io/akitaonrails/ai-memory:latest # 3. 用两条命令把你的智能体 CLI 接入进来。 包装器会处理挂载以及每个客户端的配置路径检测。

paragraphs.en: Re-run with # `--agent codex`, `--agent command-code`, `--agent devin`, `--agent opencode`, `--agent opencode2`, `--agent gemini-cli`, # `--agent grok`, `--agent kimi-code`, `--agent kiro-cli`, `--agent copilot-cli`, `--agent droid`, `--agent muse`, `--agent cline`, `--agent qwen-code`, `--agent omp`, # `--agent oh-my-pi`, `--client cursor`, # `--client gemini-cli`, `--client grok`, `--client kiro-cli`, # `--client cline`, `--client freebuff`, etc. # for additional agents; full list in docs/install.md. ai-memory install-mcp --client claude-code --apply ai-memory install-hooks --agent claude-code --apply On Linux and macOS, the Docker wrapper runs install-hooks through its checksum-verified native host client. Global options may precede the command, for example ai-memory --config /path/to/config.toml run codex ; the native client receives the complete argument list. The installed hooks therefore enforce client-side capture controls such as [capture] ignore_paths and allowlist mode before an event reaches the spool or network. Set AI_MEMORY_HOOK_PLATFORM=posix explicitly only when you need the legacy shell compatibility path; the installer warns that path cannot enforce capture policy v1.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 `--agent codex`、`--agent command-code`、`--agent devin`、`--agent opencode`、`--agent opencode2`、`--agent gemini-cli`、`--agent grok`、`--agent kimi-code`、`--agent kiro-cli`、`--agent copilot-cli`、`--agent droid`、`--agent muse`、`--agent cline`、`--agent qwen-code`、`--agent omp`、`--agent oh-my-pi`、`--client cursor`、`--client gemini-cli`、`--client grok`、`--client kiro-cli`、`--client cline`、`--client freebuff` 等选项重新运行，以支持更多智能体；完整列表见 docs/install.md。ai-memory install-mcp --client claude-code --apply ai-memory install-hooks --agent claude-code --apply 在 Linux 和 macOS 上，Docker 包装器通过经校验和验证的原生宿主客户端运行 install-hooks。 全局选项可以放在命令之前，例如 ai-memory --config /path/to/config.toml run codex；原生客户端会收到完整的参数列表。 因此，所安装的钩子会在事件到达假脱机（spool）或网络之前，强制执行诸如 [capture] ignore_paths 和允许列表模式等客户端采集控制。 仅在需要旧版 shell 兼容路径时才显式设置 AI_MEMORY_HOOK_PLATFORM=posix；安装程序会警告该路径无法强制执行采集策略 v1。

paragraphs.en: That completes the setup on Linux/macOS. Start a Claude Code session as usual: every prompt and tool call now lands in ai-memory, and the next session you open in this project will see a handoff with where you left off. On macOS the native binary is the recommended path when you do not need Docker, either through the menu bar app above or a release tarball / launchd agent . Later updates for that path use ai-memory upgrade (checksum-verified GitHub release replace + hook refresh); see docs/install.md#keeping-ai-memory-up-to-date . The same native upgrade path covers Windows x86_64 zip installs under a writable prefix (see docs/windows.md Scenario C). Upgrading a 2.x install of any kind to 3.0? paragraphs.en: Wiring another agent is the same two commands with a different name: --client codex , --agent codex , and so on for every row of the support matrix. OpenCode is version-detected by host-side commands; when generating its artifacts inside a container, use setup-agent --agent opencode --opencode-dialect v1|v2 --to /tmp/unused because the container cannot inspect the host executable. The opencode2 aliases remain force-V2 compatibility spellings. The full per-agent guide, including Windows and remote servers, is docs/install.md .
paragraphs.zh: 接入另一个智能体只需使用相同的两条命令并换一个名称：--client codex、--agent codex，支持矩阵中的每一行都以此类推。 OpenCode 通过宿主机侧的命令进行版本检测；当在容器内生成其工件时，请使用 setup-agent --agent opencode --opencode-dialect v1|v2 --to /tmp/unused，因为容器无法检查宿主机上的可执行文件。 opencode2 别名仍然是强制使用 V2 的兼容写法。 包含 Windows 和远程服务器的完整分智能体指南见 docs/install.md。

paragraphs.en: If in doubt, start your harness with ai-memory run . It is the preferred way to launch: the first time it runs a harness it auto-installs that harness's ai-memory hooks + MCP if they are missing (so capture and recall work without a separate install-hooks / install-mcp step to forget), it wires the right project scope by construction, and it adds cross-harness session continuity on top of shared memory. Everything is idempotent and one-time per harness and config home. If the server is unreachable, run warns and launches anyway with local capture spooling; run ai-memory recover after the server returns (see Degraded offline launches ). Pass --require-server to fail closed instead.
paragraphs.zh: 如果有疑问，请用 ai-memory run . 来启动你的 harness。 这是首选的启动方式：第一次运行某个 harness 时，它会自动安装该 harness 缺失的 ai-memory 钩子 + MCP（这样无需单独执行可能遗忘的 install-hooks / install-mcp 步骤即可实现捕获与召回），它在构建时就接好正确的项目作用域，并在共享记忆之上提供跨 harness 的会话连续性。 一切操作都是幂等的，且对每个 harness 和配置主目录只需执行一次。 如果服务器不可达，run 会发出警告并照常启动，同时将本地捕获内容存入暂存队列；待服务器恢复后运行 ai-memory recover（参见“降级的离线启动”一节）。 传入 --require-server 则改为 fail closed（失败即中止）。

paragraphs.en: On a real harness switch, the receiving managed agent is told to consult AI_MEMORY_PREVIOUS_SESSION_HISTORY when you ask to continue and the bounded portable packet lacks a detail. The variable names a private temporary Markdown projection created from the previous harness's checkout-validated, read-only adapter; the file disappears when the managed child exits. It is local to the launcher machine. This covers quota exhaustion and other abrupt exits where the old harness cannot write a handoff: refreshed ai-memory routing also tells the new agent that "continue", "resume", and "pick up where we left off" mean to read that file first when the three managed-run variables are present. A switch on another machine still gets the server's portable ledger and handoff, but cannot read a native transcript that exists only on the first machine.
paragraphs.zh: 在真实的工具切换场景中，当你要求继续且有界的可移植数据包缺少某个细节时，接收方的托管智能体会被告知去查阅 AI_MEMORY_PREVIOUS_SESSION_HISTORY。 该变量命名一个私有的临时 Markdown 投影，它由上一个工具的经过检出验证的只读适配器创建；当托管子进程退出时该文件即消失。 它位于启动器机器本地。 这涵盖了配额耗尽以及其他旧工具无法写入交接信息的突然退出情况：刷新后的 ai-memory 路由还会告诉新的智能体，当三个托管运行变量存在时，「继续」、「恢复」和「从我们上次停下的地方接着来」都意味着要先读取该文件。 在另一台机器上进行切换时仍会获得服务器的可移植账本和交接信息，但无法读取仅存在于第一台机器上的原生对话记录。

paragraphs.en: Without the managed launcher, a harness cut off the same way leaves no handoff at all, so the next one could pick up an older handoff or session page. When the newest captured work in the project is in another of your sessions that never ended and left no handoff after that work, the next session start carries a one-line notice that names that session. The agent then reads its newest prompts and tool results with memory_read_session_observations . The same session is listed first in memory_briefing 's recent_sessions , and memory_handoff_list names it as newer_unended_session .
paragraphs.zh: 如果没有受管启动器，以同样方式被切断的 harness 完全不会留下交接，因此下一个智能体可能会拾取较旧的交接或会话页面。 当项目中最新捕获的工作位于你的另一个从未结束且在该工作之后未留下交接的会话中时，下一次会话启动时会携带一行简短提示，指明该会话。 智能体随后使用 memory_read_session_observations 读取其最新的提示和工具结果。 同一个会话在 memory_briefing 的 recent_sessions 中排在首位，并且 memory_handoff_list 将其标记为 newer_unended_session。

paragraphs.en: In resume , type to search, use Up/Down to select a workstream, and Left/Right to choose its harness. Enter launches the selection; Escape clears a search, then cancels when the search is empty (Ctrl-C always cancels). The list scrolls and loads every checkout-local page; there is no default workstream cutoff. Use --limit N only when you want to cap the matching results. Workstreams from other repositories or worktrees are left out unless you pass --all , which lists every linked checkout (the current one first); continue still resumes the newest linked checkout from anywhere. Listing reads Git identity only; it does not scan the working tree with git status before showing the picker. Full checkpoints are still captured when launching the selected workstream.
paragraphs.zh: 在简历（resume）中，输入以搜索，使用上/下键选择工作流（workstream），使用左/右键选择其运行环境（harness）。 回车键启动所选内容；Esc 键清除搜索，当搜索为空时则取消（Ctrl-C 始终会取消）。 列表会滚动并加载每个检出本地的页面；没有默认的工作流数量上限。 仅当你想限制匹配结果数量时才使用 --limit N。 来自其他仓库或工作树的工作流不会被列出，除非你传入 --all，它会列出每个关联的检出（当前检出的排在最前）；无论如何，continue 仍会从任意位置恢复最新关联的检出。 列表仅读取 Git 身份信息；在显示选择器之前，它不会使用 git status 扫描工作树。 在启动所选工作流时，仍会捕获完整的检查点。

paragraphs.en: ai-memory uninstall --apply removes everything ai-memory installed, and only what it installed. It also clears ai-memory run 's auto-wire record, so the next managed launch wires that harness again; to keep it unwired, launch with --no-autowire or set AI_MEMORY_RUN_AUTOWIRE=false . Install commands are idempotent and write timestamped backups next to any file they touch.
paragraphs.zh: ai-memory uninstall --apply 会移除 ai-memory 安装的所有内容，且只移除它自己安装的内容。 它还会清除 ai-memory run 的自动接线记录，因此下次受管启动时会再次为该测试框架接线；若要保持不接线，请使用 --no-autowire 启动或将 AI_MEMORY_RUN_AUTOWIRE 设置为 false。 安装命令具有幂等性，并会在其触碰的任何文件旁边写入带时间戳的备份。

paragraphs.en: This flake ships a NixOS module ( nixosModules.default ) with a systemd.services.ai-memory unit: a dedicated ai-memory system user ( nologin , no linger) plus a hardened systemd sandbox ( ProtectSystem = "strict" , empty capability sets, MemoryDenyWriteExecute , RestrictAddressFamilies , and the rest; see nix/systemd-sandbox.nix ). Packaged FHS units under packaging/systemd/ keep their existing lighter hardening. The flake exports packages for x86_64-linux , aarch64-linux , and aarch64-darwin . Intel macOS remains supported by the release tarball and Homebrew, but not by the pinned Nixpkgs revision.

paragraphs.en: Two opt-in HTTP surfaces build on the same browser sign-in, and both are off by default. serve --enable-session-management lets signed-in users inspect sessions and purge the ones they own ( docs/session-management.md ). serve --enable-self-service-keys lets them issue and revoke their own aim_ API keys ( docs/self-service-keys.md ).

paragraphs.en: The server binds to loopback only by default. A fresh ai-memory init also mints a root bearer token into the data dir, which the hooks, the CLI and the ai-memory mcp-bridge stdio bridge read from there; it is never written into a harness config. An install created before that default (and the Docker quick-start) runs without auth until ai-memory auth enable , and ai-memory status says so. From there, hardening is incremental: a bearer token for the LAN, per-user accounts, OIDC device auth for hooks, TLS via a reverse proxy. Capture is sanitized at a typed privacy boundary before anything is stored, and per-repository [capture] rules can exclude paths or invert to allowlist mode. A repository can also route its capture to a different server than the one the hooks were installed against. Human login beyond loopback requires an HTTPS posture by default. Operators who explicitly accept plaintext passwords, cookies, credentials, and memory traffic on a private LAN can opt in with serve --allow-insecure-human-auth ; the server never enables that exception implicitly.
paragraphs.zh: 服务器默认仅绑定到回环地址。 全新的 ai-memory init 还会在数据目录中生成一个根 bearer 令牌，钩子、CLI 和 ai-memory mcp-bridge stdio 桥接从那里读取它；它绝不会被写入 harness 配置。 在该默认设置（以及 Docker 快速入门）之前创建的安装，在运行 ai-memory auth enable 之前没有认证，ai-memory status 会说明这一点。 从那里开始，加固是渐进式的：用于局域网的 bearer 令牌、按用户的账户、用于钩子的 OIDC 设备认证、通过反向代理的 TLS。 在存储任何内容之前，捕获会在类型化的隐私边界处进行清洗，并且每个仓库的 [capture] 规则可以排除路径或反转为白名单模式。 仓库还可以将其捕获路由到与安装钩子时所用服务器不同的服务器。 回环之外的人类登录默认要求 HTTPS 姿态。 明确接受在私有局域网上以明文传输密码、cookie、凭据和内存流量的运维人员，可以通过 serve --allow-insecure-human-auth 选择加入；服务器绝不会隐式启用该例外。

paragraphs.en: One Rust binary runs an MCP/HTTP server and owns one data directory:
paragraphs.zh: 一个 Rust 二进制文件运行一个 MCP/HTTP 服务器，并拥有一个数据目录：

paragraphs.en: <data_dir>/ ├── wiki/ # markdown source of truth, git-versioned ├── raw/ # immutable sanitized managed-workstream transcript segments ├── db/ # SQLite indexes, including FTS5, entities, and embeddings ├── models/ # reserved for local embedding models └── logs/ # rolling tracing output Hooks POST observations to the server. The server serializes writes through one SQLite writer, compiles session observations into markdown pages, and serves retrieval through FTS5, entity-match and graph-neighbor RRF, optional vector RRF, an observation-evidence stream that lifts a session's page when its captured turns match (on by default), bounded source-authority adjustment, and bounded raw-observation fallback for non-global searches.
